create_SDFViewer_with_pointcloud: create an SDFViewer instance from an SDF pointcloud with shape n x 4 for interactive 3D visualization
create_SDFViewer_with_grid: create an SDFViewer instance from a 3D voxel grid and grid-to-world transform matrix for visualization
create_SDFViewer_with_grid_pc: create an SDFViewer instance from a grid pointcloud with shape m x n x p x 4+ for multi-SDF comparison
run_save_slice_images: run save_slice_imgs on an SDFViewer to export all z-slice pointcloud images as PNG files to a directory
run_save_slice_function: run the save_slice function to render a single SDF slice as a colored 2D image with a colormap and z-axis label
